thesis: Responsibility must be sustainable rather than punish sensitivity with limitless work.

ideas.statement: Emergency reasons may exceed fair shares, but enduring care requires redistribution and reform; rest and personal projects are goods to protect, not mere leftovers.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: No universal quota settles duty; guilt can manipulate or rightly remind, special relations matter without unlimited privilege, and past consent must remain revisable.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No universal quota settles duty; guilt can manipulate or rightly remind, special relations matter without unlimited privilege, and past consent must remain revisable.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read directly; moral disagreement and finite demands retained.
